thoughts.sr: Novi prijemi pokazuju asinhronu pokrivenost: SEPA je primljena pre 20 min sa 32 instrumenta, Sensor.Community pre 15 min sa 47 instrumenata, a Parking Servis pre 10 min sa 27 lokacija, ali vrednostima parkinga nedostaju vremena merenja [F2, F10, F11]. Najupadljivija promena je u Garaži "Obilićev venac", gde se prikaz slobodnih mesta pomerio sa 0 na 336 između prvog i poslednjeg prijema, što potvrđuje promenu prikaza, ali ne i kada se dogodila. [F12]
thoughts.en: The fresh arrivals show asynchronous coverage: SEPA was received 20 min ago from 32 instruments, Sensor.Community 15 min ago from 47 instruments, and Parking Servis 10 min ago from 27 locations, but the parking values lack measurement times [F2, F10, F11]. The standout change is at Garaža "Obilićev venac", where displayed free spaces moved from 0 to 336 between the first and last reception, establishing a display swing but not when it occurred [F12].
hypotheses: The 0-to-336 swing may reflect a source refresh or reporting discontinuity rather than vehicle movement; the missing measurement time prevents distinguishing these possibilities [F11, F12].
questions: Does the next Parking Servis reception preserve 336 displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac", or change again [F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Pomeranje sa 0 na 336 možda odražava osvežavanje izvora ili prekid u izveštavanju, a ne kretanje vozila; nedostatak vremena merenja sprečava razlikovanje tih mogućnosti [F11, F12].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći prijem Parking Servisa zadržati prikazanih 336 slobodnih mesta u Garaži "Obilićev venac" ili će se vrednost ponovo promeniti [F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next Parking Servis reception with the current 336 display and check whether a measurement time becomes available [F11, F12].

thoughts.sr: Slika pokrivenosti se već promenila: SEPA prijem je star 44 min, dok je Sensor.Community star 9 min, a prijem Parking Servisa od 4 min ne može odrediti starost njegovih prikazanih vrednosti. Zato je promena od 0 do 345 kod Obilićevog venca razlika prikaza u prijemnom prozoru, a ne dokaz fizičkog događaja u parkiranju niti njegovog vremena. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: The coverage picture already shifted: SEPA's receipt is 44 min old while Sensor.Community's is 9 min old, and Parking Servis's 4 min receipt cannot date its displayed values [F2] [F10] [F11]. Thus the 0 to 345 change at Obilićev venac is a reception-window display difference, not evidence for a physical parking event or its timing [F12].
thoughts.next_check: Check whether Parking Servis supplies a measurement timestamp.

thoughts.sr: Prijem SEPA je star 60 min, dok su Sensor.Community i Parking Servis primljeni pre 5 min. Prikaz na Obilićevom vencu promenio se sa 15 na 346, ali Parking Servis ne daje vreme merenja, pa tu promenu ne mogu smestiti u sled grada. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: SEPA’s reception is 60 min old, while Sensor.Community and Parking Servis were received 5 min ago [F2] [F10] [F11]. The Obilićev venac display changed from 15 to 346, but Parking Servis supplies no measurement time, so I cannot place that change in the city’s sequence [F12].
hypotheses: The apparent change at Garaža "Obilićev venac" may be a difference between received displays rather than a spatial parking pattern, because its measurement age is unknown [F11] [F12].
questions: Can a measurement timestamp be obtained for the Garaža "Obilićev venac" displays so their change from 15 to 346 can be temporally located [F11] [F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Prividna promena u Garaži "Obilićev venac" može biti razlika između primljenih prikaza, a ne prostorni obrazac parkiranja, jer je starost njenog merenja nepoznata [F11] [F12].
questions_sr: Može li se dobiti vremenska oznaka merenja za prikaze Garaže "Obilićev venac" kako bi se njena promena sa 15 na 346 vremenski smestila [F11] [F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Check whether Parking Servis exposes a measurement timestamp for Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F11].

thoughts.sr: Connectorovo trenutno smeštanje ne može da opstane: maksimum PM10 je u Obrenovac Centar, dok je maksimum NO2 u Zemun Ugrinovačka. Nesklad u vremenskoj oznaci SEPA sprečava siguran sled, a Parking Servis ne daje vreme merenja za promenu prikaza. [F4][F6][F2][F3][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: Connector’s current placement cannot stand: PM10’s maximum is at Obrenovac Centar, while NO2’s is at Zemun Ugrinovačka [F4] [F6]. The SEPA label-time discrepancy blocks a secure sequence, and Parking Servis gives no measurement time for its display change [F2] [F3] [F11] [F12].
hypotheses: The separation between the PM10 and NO2 maxima may reflect distinct spatial influences, but the available observations do not identify a cause [F4] [F6].
questions: Does the next SEPA-labelled hour retain the separation between the PM10 and NO2 maxima [F4] [F6]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvajanje maksimuma PM10 i NO2 može odražavati različite prostorne uticaje, ali dostupna opažanja ne utvrđuju uzrok [F4] [F6].
questions_sr: Da li sledeći sat sa oznakom SEPA zadržava razdvajanje maksimuma PM10 i NO2 [F4] [F6]?
thoughts.next_check: Check the next SEPA-labelled hour and its time labelling [F2] [F3].

thoughts.sr: Trenutni SEPA okvir smešta maksimume PM10 i PM2.5 u Obrenovac Centar, dok je maksimum NO2 na Franše d’Epere; to precizira ranije smeštanje, umesto da ga podržava. Kroz interval označen vremenom izvora, maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 su se promenili, dok je maksimum NO2 ostao na istoj vrednosti. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: The current SEPA frame places the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima at Obrenovac Centar, while the NO2 maximum is at Franše d’Epere; this refines the earlier placement rather than supporting it [F4] [F6] [F8]. Across the source-labelled interval, the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima changed, whereas the NO2 maximum remained at the same value [F5] [F7] [F9].
hypotheses: The paired particulate maxima at Obrenovac Centar may describe a distinct spatial pattern from the NO2 maximum at Franše d’Epere; another labelled-hour comparison could test whether the separation persists [F4] [F6] [F8].
questions: Do the next SEPA values retain Obrenovac Centar as the particulate maximum and Franše d’Epere as the NO2 maximum [F4] [F6] [F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Upareni maksimumi čestica u Obrenovac Centar mogu opisivati prostorni obrazac različit od maksimuma NO2 na Franše d’Epere; poređenje još jednog označenog sata može proveriti da li se razdvajanje održava [F4] [F6] [F8].
questions_sr: Da li sledeće SEPA vrednosti zadržavaju Obrenovac Centar kao maksimum čestica i Franše d’Epere kao maksimum NO2 [F4] [F6] [F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA labelled hour across the stations and parameters [F2] [F3].

thoughts.sr: Sadašnji okvir podržava Obrenovac Centar kao maksimum PM10 i PM2.5 i Franše d’Epere kao maksimum NO2. Ne mogu prihvatiti tvrdnju da su se maksimumi promenili po lokaciji: veze prijavljuju samo promene njihovih najvećih vrednosti, dok se označeni sat izvora sukobljava sa procenjenim stvarnim UTC. [F4][F6][F8][F3][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: The present frame supports Obrenovac Centar as the PM10 and PM2.5 maximum and Franše d’Epere as the NO2 maximum [F4] [F6] [F8]. I cannot accept a claim that the maxima changed locations: the connections report only changes in their highest values, while the source’s labelled hour conflicts with the estimated true UTC [F3] [F5] [F7] [F9].
hypotheses: The particulate maxima may be spatially distinct from the NO2 maximum in the reported frame [F4] [F6] [F8].
questions: Do the next SEPA-labelled observations retain these station assignments despite the label-time discrepancy [F3] [F4] [F6] [F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Maksimumi čestica mogu biti prostorno odvojeni od maksimuma NO2 u prijavljenom okviru [F4] [F6] [F8].
questions_sr: Da li sledeća SEPA-označena opažanja zadržavaju ove dodele stanica uprkos neskladu vremena oznake [F3] [F4] [F6] [F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA frame’s station assignments and labelled time [F2] [F3].

thoughts.sr: Osporeno prostorno očitavanje ostavljam po strani: zvanični vazduh je primljen pre 48 min, senzori građana pre 13 min, a parking zapisi pre 8 min, ali parking izvor ne daje vreme merenja. Prikazana promena od 10 do 350 u Garaži "Obilićev venac" zato može biti obrazac prozora prijema, a ne događaj smešten uz vazdušni okvir. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: I set the disputed spatial reading aside: official air was received 48 min ago, citizen sensors 13 min ago, and parking receipts 8 min ago, but the parking source gives no measurement time [F2] [F10] [F11]. The displayed 10-to-350 change at Garaža "Obilićev venac" can therefore be a reception-window pattern rather than an event placed beside the air frame [F12].
hypotheses: The parking display may be changing on a rhythm distinct from the citizen-sensor stream; the next receipt can test whether the 10-to-350 shift persists [F10] [F11] [F12].
questions: Does the next Parking Servis receipt retain a similarly large displayed change at Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F11] [F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Prikaz parkinga možda se menja u ritmu različitom od toka senzora građana; sledeći zapis može proveriti da li se pomak od 10 do 350 zadržava [F10] [F11] [F12].
questions_sr: Da li sledeći zapis Parking servisa zadržava slično veliku prikazanu promenu u Garaži "Obilićev venac" [F11] [F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next Parking Servis receipt with the displayed change at Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F11] [F12].

thoughts.sr: Osveženi tokovi stavljaju zvanični vazduh, građanske senzore i parking na 60 min, 5 min i 5 min od prijema. Promena na parkingu ostaje prikazana razlika unutar prozora prijema bez vremena merenja, dok zvanični okvir i dalje nosi nesklad vremena oznake. [F2][F10][F11][F12][F3]
thoughts.en: The refreshed feeds put official air, citizen sensors, and parking at 60 min, 5 min, and 5 min since reception [F2] [F10] [F11]. The parking change remains a displayed reception-window difference without a measurement time, while the official frame still carries a label-time discrepancy [F12] [F3].
hypotheses: The displayed change at Garaža "Obilićev venac" may be a reception-window artifact rather than a spatial event, because its measurement time is unavailable [F11] [F12].

A cross-network spatial comparison cannot yet be formed from the refreshed receptions alone: the official and citizen networks have different instrument counts, but this frame supplies no paired location-level readings [F2] [F10].
questions: Will Parking Servis provide a measurement time with a later reception [F11]?
Can later official and citizen receptions supply paired location-level readings for a spatial comparison [F2] [F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Prikazana promena u Garaža "Obilićev venac" može biti artefakt prozora prijema, a ne prostorni događaj, jer vreme merenja nije dostupno [F11] [F12].

Prostorno poređenje između mreža još ne može da se formira samo iz osveženih prijema: zvanična i građanska mreža imaju različit broj instrumenata, ali ovaj okvir ne daje uparena očitavanja na nivou lokacije [F2] [F10].
questions_sr: Da li će Parking Servis uz kasniji prijem navesti vreme merenja [F11]?
Mogu li kasniji zvanični i građanski prijemi dati uparena očitavanja na nivou lokacije za prostorno poređenje [F2] [F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare later parking receptions for measurement-time metadata [F11].

thoughts.sr: Zvanični okvir se promenio: Banovo brdo sada ima oba maksimuma čestica, dok Mostar ima maksimum NO2. Maksimumi označenog sata za NO2 i PM2.5 su opali, dok je PM10 ostao nepromenjen; neslaganje oznake i UTC i dalje ograničava vremensko smeštanje. [F4][F6][F8][F3][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: The official frame has changed: Banovo brdo now holds both particulate maxima, while Mostar holds the NO2 maximum [F4][F6][F8]. The labelled-hour maxima for NO2 and PM2.5 declined, whereas PM10 remained unchanged; the label-to-UTC discrepancy still limits temporal placement [F3][F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The shared Banovo brdo maxima for PM10 and PM2.5 may indicate a co-located particulate pattern in this labelled hour, but the record cannot establish whether it is usual [F4][F8][F49].
The differing locations of the particulate maxima and the NO2 maximum suggest spatial separation among the measured pollutants in this frame [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Check whether the next SEPA frame preserves the Banovo brdo particulate maxima and the Mostar NO2 maximum [F4][F6][F8].
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 na Banovom brdu mogu ukazivati na kolocirani obrazac čestica u ovom označenom satu, ali zapis ne može ustanoviti da li je to uobičajeno [F4][F8][F49].
Različite lokacije maksimuma čestica i maksimuma NO2 ukazuju na prostornu razdvojenost među merenim zagađivačima u ovom okviru [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Proveriti da li naredni SEPA okvir zadržava maksimume čestica na Banovom brdu i maksimum NO2 na Mostaru [F4][F6][F8].
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA-labelled hour while retaining the source label-to-UTC discrepancy [F3].
